name: Adalaj Stepwell
editorialSummary: Ancient architectural site featuring a stepwell dating to late 1400s with intricate wall carvings.

name: Rani ki Vav, Patan
editorialSummary: Historic stepwell with elaborate carvings & pillars, originally built as a memorial to a king.

name: Modhera Sun Temple
editorialSummary: Monumental Hindu sun temple from 1026 AD, noted for its elaborate sculptures & sacred reservoir.

name: Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park
editorialSummary: UNESCO-listed remains of a 16th century Hindu city with fortresses, temples, mosques & palaces.

name: Girnar Hill
editorialSummary: Hundreds of Hindu & Jain temples dot this forested mountain, a well-known pilgrimage destination.

name: Uparkot Fort, Junagadh
editorialSummary: Imposing ancient fort, dating to c. 319 BC, with towering ramparts, Buddhist caves & 15th-c. mosque.

name: Laxmi Vilas Palace, Vadodara
editorialSummary: Massive, 19th-century palace in landscaped surrounds featuring an art museum, concert hall & zoo.

name: Marine National Park, Gulf of Kutch
editorialSummary: Nature sanctuary offering beach walks & snorkeling among coral reefs & diverse marine life.

name: Polo Forest (Vijaynagar)
editorialSummary: Tropical forest home to species like panthers & leopards, plus several centuries-old ruined temples.

name: Kankaria Lake
editorialSummary: Manmade lake from the 1500s, with amusement rides, adrenaline attractions & parks lining its shores.

name: Gateway of India
editorialSummary: Grand, Indo-Saracenic-style, 26m-tall triumphal stone arch, built on the waterfront in 1924.

name: Elephanta Caves
editorialSummary: Island with an ornately sculpted, 7th-century cave temple dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
editorialSummary: This high Gothic Victorian landmark is the centerpiece of the city's suburban train network.

name: Haji Ali Dargah
editorialSummary: Mughal-style island mausoleum, holding the tomb of Pir Haji Ali Shah Bukhari, a Muslim saint.

name: Siddhivinayak Temple
editorialSummary: Dedicated to Ganesha, this grand Hindu temple features an inner gold-plated roof & carved doors.

name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park
editorialSummary: Sprawling, forested park home to the ancient Kanheri Caves, a lion & tiger safari & nature trails.

name: Ellora Caves
editorialSummary: Grand archeological site from the 6th to 10th century featuring religious monuments cut into rock.

name: Bibi Ka Maqbara
editorialSummary: Marble Mughal mausoleum built in the mid-1600s with a garden, fountains & intricate carvings.

name: Daulatabad Fort
editorialSummary: 1300s fortification made up of concentric walls, bastions, tunnels, cannon posts & bridges.

name: Shaniwar Wada
editorialSummary: Peshwa palace fort built in the 1740s, with a main gate big enough to let elephants pass through.

name: Sinhagad Fort
editorialSummary: Historic hilltop fort with a memorial for 17th-century emperors, plus a temple to the goddess Kali.

name: Raigad Fort
editorialSummary: Ruins of towers, temples & reservoirs in a hilltop plateau complex accessible by a single path.

name: Trimbakeshwar Temple, Nashik
editorialSummary: Ancient temple to the Hindu god Shiva with a sacred pond thought to be the start of Godavari River.

name: Mahalaxmi Temple, Kolhapur
editorialSummary: Majestic, 12th-century Hindu temple, known for its elaborate sculptural details.

name: New Palace, Kolhapur
editorialSummary: Museum in the 1884 palace of Chhatrapatis of Kolhapur, showcasing a collection of his possessions.

name: Tarkarli Beach
editorialSummary: Scuba-diving & snorkeling are popular activities along this sandy stretch of coast with hotels.

name: Sindhudurg Fort
editorialSummary: Preserved 17th-century fortress accessible by ferry, with timed self-guided tours & sea views.

name: Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve
editorialSummary: Long-established national park known for its dense woodlands, diverse flora & Bengal tiger reserve.

name: Lonar Crater Lake
editorialSummary: Unique, oval-shaped lake formed by a meteorite impact & surrounded by forest & Hindu temple ruins.

name: Pratapgad Fort
editorialSummary: Landmark & famous battle site built on a hilltop in the 1650s with scenic views & a Hindu shrine.

name: Karla Caves
editorialSummary: Ancient rock-carved cave temples housing a monastery, soaring halls, statues & intricate columns.

name: Calangute Beach
editorialSummary: Big, popular beach with water sports, such as boating, water skiing & parasailing, plus food stalls.

name: Anjuna Beach
editorialSummary: Popular tourist beach providing activities such as parasailing, jet ski & banana boat rentals.

name: Chapora Fort
editorialSummary: Ruined centuries-old fortress on a headland, a popular vantage point for sunsets over the sea.

name: Fort Aguada
editorialSummary: 1612 Portuguese fortress offering ocean views & an abandoned lighthouse erected in 1864.

name: Basilica of Bom Jesus, Old Goa
editorialSummary: Completed in 1605, this Baroque Catholic church contains the tomb of Saint Francis Xavier.

name: Sé Cathedral, Old Goa
editorialSummary: Roman Catholic place of worship built by Portuguese colonialists and still hosting regular services.

name: Dudhsagar Falls
editorialSummary: 3-streamed waterfall, named for its milky waters, with swimming pools surrounded by forest.

name: Palolem Beach
editorialSummary: Uncrowded stretch of white sand with calm waters, a restaurant and silent disco music parties.

name: Colva Beach
editorialSummary: Sprawling, scenic beachfront lined with open-air eateries, bars & nightspots overlooking the sea.

name: Benaulim Beach
editorialSummary: Spacious, low-key sand beach dotted with shacks, offering sunbeds & casual dining.

name: Cabo de Rama Fort
googleName: Cabo de Rama Fort South Goa
editorialSummary: Tranquil remains of a 1763 Portguese fortress, perched atop a seaside cliff, with a small chapel.

name: Shri Mangeshi Temple
editorialSummary: Domed temple with a 7-story tower dedicated to Manguesh, an incarnation of the god Shiva.

name: Diu Fort
editorialSummary: Built in the 16th century by the Portuguese, this sandstone fort features a lighthouse & 3 churches.

name: Ghoghla Beach, Diu
editorialSummary: Relaxed strip of sand beach known for its gentle waves, plus a group of nearby restaurants.

name: St Paul's Church, Diu
editorialSummary: Built by Portuguese colonists in 1610, this church features a baroque facade & intricate woodwork.

name: Jampore Beach, Daman
editorialSummary: Coastal hangout with a sand beach, casual restaurants & activities such as parasailing & boat rides.

name: Vanganga Lake & Garden, Silvassa
editorialSummary: Peaceful & leafy garden with flower beds, kids' activities & a lake with boats for hire.
